_comment: Debt ratchet baselines (specs/164-quality-ratchets). `yarn hygiene` fails any change that raises a count above its baseline. When your change lowers a count, lower the baseline here in the same PR so the improvement is locked in.
_comment_sc004_exceptions: spec 167 SC-004 asks that no source module exceed ~350 lines except by documented exception. It is enforced by `moduleLineCaps` below (R9-16); this note records why each exception exists. Modules over the line that no story in spec 167 touched, with why: DopplerMode.js and AnalysisMode.js are feature modes, flagged as candidates for a later phase; PinSetMode.js is the shared pin-set mode Harmonics and Sidebands are built from — extracting it took HarmonicsMode.js from 1054 to 373 and let Sidebands (issue #241) land in ~310; keyboardControl.js and events.js are input handling; GramFrameAPI.js is the public surface plus its failure handling; types.js is declarations, capped rather than exempt so it ratchets like the rest. main.js is over the line too, and is the one module here that a later phase should split. table.js came down from 713 to 151 and is scaffold-only.
_comment_moduleLines: spec 167 SC-004, now enforced (R9-16). `moduleLineCaps` records every module currently over `moduleLineDefault`; a module without an entry must stay under the default, so a new one cannot quietly grow past the line and then be grandfathered in. Caps only ever fall: when a module shrinks by 10 lines or more, `yarn hygiene` says so and the cap is lowered in the same PR. The caps below are the sizes at the moment the ratchet was introduced -- they record the debt, they do not bless it.
_comment_moduleLines_reset: The caps were first measured on the branch that introduced the ratchet (#302). Six other PRs merged to main between that measurement and that merge -- #295, #298, #299, #305, #306 among them -- so the caps landed already below the tree they were meant to guard and main failed its own gate. They are re-measured here against main, once. This is the only reset: from this commit the ratchet is live, and a module that grows past its cap is a regression to fix rather than a number to raise.
_comment_specTypeErrors: R9-10. `yarn typecheck` (tsconfig.json) covers src/, tests/helpers, tests/unit and scripts/ and must stay at zero. The Playwright spec files carry the rest -- mostly unguarded nulls from `boundingBox()` and `querySelector` inside `page.evaluate` -- and are counted here through tsconfig.specs.json so the debt is visible and falling rather than invisible. At zero, fold tests/**/*.js into tsconfig.json and delete tsconfig.specs.json.
_comment_instanceSurface: specs/167-structural-refactor Story 5. instanceStateReachIns counts lines containing `instance.state` under src/; instanceFields counts class-field declarations between `export class GramFrame` and its constructor in src/main.js.
_comment_instanceFields_168: Raised 11 -> 12 by spec 168: `player` is a fifth grouped sub-object (the audio element, its controller and follow loop share one lifetime), not a flat field returning to the surface.
